mods.name: Flashback Keystrokes Bridge
mods.description: Merekam keystroke saat Flashback merekam replay, dan menampilkannya kembali sebagai overlay saat replay diputar.

releases.notes:
Bridge mod that records your keystrokes while Flashback records a replay, then plays them back as a synced HUD overlay when you watch it. Same look as Clean Keystrokes' HUD.

**Requirements**
- [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
- [Clean Keystrokes](https://modrinth.com/mod/clean-keystrokes)
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21.11

**Installation**
Drop `flashback-keystrokes-bridge-0.3.0+1.21.11.jar` in your `mods` folder along with the mods above.

See the [README](https://github.com/galihjulianto/flashback-keystrokes-bridge) for commands and full details.

readmeSummary: Records your keystrokes while Flashback records a replay, then plays them back as a synced HUD overlay when you watch it. Same look as Clean Keystrokes' HUD. Good for PvP clips and highlights.
